column1: # spu_float_edges: each SPU floating-point instruction class over its hardest cases.
# Columns, tab-separated. Registers and the FPSCR are 128-bit hex, most
# significant word first; "_" separators are ignored.
#   asm     the case's instructions, ";"-separated, SPU assembler syntax;
#   fpscr   the FPSCR written with fscrwr before the case
#           $3 and the FPSCR read with fscrrd after the case
#   source  where the expected value comes from. "documented" means the
#           cited rule and the engine's exact computation, not yet measured
#           on hardware; a hardware vector replaces it with "measured".
